Auto-synced & secret-scrubbed after every clean PEN turn via `node C:\ECMD\scripts\sync-ai-mirror.mjs --push`. Never use slow browser_agent screen takeovers unless explicitly requested by the owner. • Lean Localhost Routes (Zero Dev Clutter on Customer Pages): - Dev header (`AppHeader`) renders ONLY on `/workflow` (`Workflow & Boot-Up`) and `/errors` (`Errors & Issues`, with live count badge, top-right `✓ 0 Errors` / `🚨 N Critical` / `📐 K Mobile/Tablet Queued` status pill, & `Live Site (/) ↗` link). - Customer-facing Plasmic routes (`/` & catch-all Plasmic pages) render with ZERO dev header clutter. `/plasmic-host` renders ONLY `` (CSR-only via `createRoot`). • 0ms Unified Errors Node (`

  Single 0ms machine-readable error feed aggregating Compiler/TSC (`/ai-telemetry.json`), Plasmic Canvas 3-tier diagnostics (`/plasmic-diagnostics.json`: Desktop > 1024px · Tablet 768px–1024px · Mobile < 768px + Critical Across All), and DEV-only Browser Runtime JS & Unhandled Promise Rejection errors (`/__ecmd-runtime-error` -> `/runtime-errors.json`, last 50 deduplicated).

• Active Engine: ECMD PEN v4.2 runs via `epen` -> C:\ECMD\scripts\Start-EcmdPen.ps1 -> C:\ECMD\scripts\run-pen-task.mjs invoking:
  `agy.exe --dangerously-skip-permissions --output-format stream-json --add-dir C:\ECMD -p "Execute the complete engineering task piped via stdin above."`
• CRITICAL `-p` LAST-ARGUMENT RULE: `-p ""` MUST ALWAYS be the VERY LAST elements of the `agy.exe` args array when piping a task via stdin (never put `--print` / `-p` before `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, or `agy` consumes the next flag as the prompt!).
• Per-Turn SHA-1 Checksum Diffing & Lightweight Telemetry: PEN v4.2 hashes workspace files before & after each turn so `filesChanged` (persisted to Supabase `public.ecmd_pen_turns` and lightweight `public/ai-telemetry.json`) records ONLY files actually created/modified/deleted during THAT turn, preserves recursive `walkForToolsAndText` NDJSON logging, and classifies `root agent idle; waiting for...` as `AGY ORCHESTRATOR` (`isWarn = false`).
• Auth & Cost: Owner personal @gmail.com Google OAuth ($0.00/turn, Gemini 4). Multi-line #ECMD_AI! blocks edit files natively on disk inside C:\ECMD\emerald-coast-detailing-hub and query Supabase lvynkeuceiqxafgpgdvs via `node scripts/ecmd-sql.mjs ""`.
• Single-Turn Self-Healing & Auto-Mirror: Runs `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx vitest run` automatically in-turn until 0 errors remain, then runs `node C:\ECMD\scripts\sync-ai-mirror.mjs --push` non-fatally to refresh `mlhammes2/ecmd-ai-mirror`.

• CLI Model & Account Notes: Check available models with `agy models`, set `--effort` (`low|medium|high|xhigh|max`), or use interactive `/usage` and `/logout` when managing CLI auth/session state.
• Non-Interactive Shell Guard: NEVER run PowerShell `Invoke-WebRequest` or `iwr` without `-UseBasicParsing` (prefer Node `fetch()` with `AbortSignal.timeout(8000)` or `curl.exe -s` for all HTTP checks so non-interactive stdin NEVER hangs on PowerShell's Security Warning prompt).

--- 3. MANDATORY POWERSHELL & RUNNER BOOT-SYNC LAW (ZERO DRIFT) ---
• Every PowerShell profile or `C:\ECMD\scripts\*` runner change MUST be synced in the EXACT SAME TURN to ALL four sources of truth:
  1) `ECMD_SIDEBAR_BOOT_PROMPT` (`src/lib/ecmdBootPrompt.ts` powering `/workflow`),
  2) `AGENTS.md`,
  3) `GEMINI.md` (kept compact < 6 KB), and
  4) `public.ecmd_external_ai_cms` in Supabase via `node scripts/ecmd-sql.mjs`.

--- 4. STRICT DUAL-AI BOUNDARY & EXISTING CUSTOMER API KEY ---
• 1) ADMIN & DEV ENGINE (Antigravity `agy`): Personal @gmail.com Google OAuth ($0.00/turn). Strictly for owner/admin local code engineering, Plasmic code components, SQL migrations, and internal ops via `epen`. • 2) CUSTOMER-FACING SITE AI (Dedicated `GEMINI_API_KEY` — ALREADY OWNED & CONFIGURED): The owner ALREADY owns and has configured a dedicated `GEMINI_API_KEY` for public customer-facing website AI (quotes, package helpers, customer chat) running inside serverless Supabase Edge Functions (`ecmd-carbon-bridge` / `geminiAssistant`), 100% isolated from Antigravity (`agy`). --- 5. 3-TIER BREAKPOINT ENGINE (Desktop -> Tablet -> Mobile), `registerEcmdComponent` & ZERO-INLINE-WIDTH ROOT LAW ---
• Universal Component Wrapper Law: EVERY Plasmic code component in `src/plasmic-init.ts` MUST be registered via `registerEcmdComponent(Component, meta)` (ZERO bare `registerComponent(` calls, enforced by `src/test/plasmic-init-styles.test.ts`). Auto-populates `ECMD_REGISTERED_COMPONENTS` with 0 KB production overhead (`!import.meta.env.DEV` renders `` directly). In `DEV`, `DevTelemetryObserver` NEVER wraps `` in a `display: contents` or outer sizing `
`—it forwards `className` and `style` directly onto `` and observes the rendered root via a zero-footprint sibling marker so `DEV` and `PROD` share the exact same single DOM box-model.
• Zero-Inline-Width Root Law: NEVER hardcode inline `style={{ width: "100%" }}` on any Plasmic code component's root element. Place default root sizing (`width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;`) in zero-specificity `:where(...)` CSS (`src/lib/ecmdRootSizing.ts` + `src/styles.css`) and/or whitelisted `defaultStyles: { width: "100%" }` in `src/plasmic-init.ts` so Plasmic Studio Design -> `Width` (e.g. `980px`), `Max Width`, `Min Width`, `Margin`, and `Align` win 100% of the time with zero inline specificity battles. Always forward `className` to the single root sizing box (never onto inner slots).
• 3-Tier Breakpoint Hook & Action Router (`src/lib/useEcmdBreakpoint.ts`): `useEcmdBreakpoint(mobileBreakpointPx = 768, tabletBreakpointPx = 1024)` resolves `"desktop"` (`> 1024px`, e.g. `desktop-1440`), `"tablet"` (`768px–1024px`, e.g. `tablet-834`), and `"mobile"` (`< 768px`, e.g. `mobile-414`), returning `{ viewportMode, isDesktop, isTablet, isMobile, viewportWidthPx, artboardTag }`, stamping `data-ecmd-viewport`, and routing `data-ecmd-action-mobile` / `data-ecmd-action-tablet` / `data-ecmd-action-desktop` (falling back to `data-ecmd-action`) via `resolveBreakpointAction` / `executeBreakpointAction`.

- Each Group state (default, hover, focus, selected, selectedHover, disabled) supports borderMode ("unset" | "none" | "custom"), borderNone (boolean), borderWidth (string, 0-16px), and borderStyle ("solid" | "dashed" | "dotted" | "none").
